title: Cronus
extract:
The Cronus is a ceramic sword wielded by Captain Vor.
It can be sold for  5,000.

Stance slot has  polarity, matching  Crimson Dervish,  Vengeful Revenant and  Swooping Falcon stance.

Acquisition
The Cronus's main blueprint can be obtained from defeating Captain Vor on Tolstoj, Mercury.

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.
See Mission Rewards#Standard Missions for definitions on reward table rotations.
For more detailed definitions and information,
visit here.

Notes
The Cronus Blueprint is only dropped for the host of the squad.

Trivia
Cronus (alternatively Cronos or Kronos) is the youngest of the twelve titans in Greek mythology and father of Zeus, Hades, and Poseidon.
Since Update 7.8 (2013-04-19), the Cronus Blueprint will only be a guaranteed reward the first time Tolstoj is completed and its drop chance exponentially decreases with each repetition. This was put in place to prevent credit farming.
The Cronus was the original melee weapon of the Stalker before update Update 7.11 (2013-05-17).
Despite being classed as a Tenno weapon, the Cronus is wielded by Captain Vor, who is Grineer.
This would make Cronus the first weapon in the game to be used by an enemy whose faction is not related to the weapon itself.
It's possible that Captain Vor took the Cronus from a previously defeated Tenno.
